about_the_game:
IN THIS DEMO

Play through the first world of Buster Jam, including the first level, boss-fight, cutscenes, and a preview of Endless Mode.

Buster Jam is a playable cartoon, focused on fast-paced mini-game action. Explore jam-packed worlds and survive an onslaught of wild animated boss-fights. Its lively style and soundtrack hold inspiration from the '90s and early 2000s, with a splash of its own modern flair.

STORY

Evil sorcerer the Wizard has come out of his long retirement to rule the world. Wrecking crew Buster and Bridget will have to make their way through a variety of zany worlds, and an onslaught of wacky boss-fight scenarios if they want to save the land from a 'Wizard-topia'. With their explosive expertise, and friends along the way, the Wizard will be no match for these go-lucky bombheads.

GAMEPLAY

STORY MODE (World 1 In Demo)

Explore each world top-down platforming style as you progress through the Story Mode of Buster Jam. Each world is absolutely jam-packed with content. Buster and Bridget will find themselves meeting all sorts of wild characters, crazy micro-game filled scenarios, and solving puzzles! Maybe they'll even find some secrets along the way?

ENDLESS MODE (Preview in Demo)

Compete with others around the world on an online leaderboard in Endless Mode! Survive an onslaught of fast-paced micro-games with a limited amount of health points. As the heat rises, the tables may turn, throwing unexpected gimmicks right at your face. Think you got what it takes?

WHAT NOW?

Buster Jam is still in development, and planned to release soon. Wishlist the game to help us, and keep up to date with the project!
